Aggiorna Compagnia Aerea

Setup Compagnia Aerea

import { Component} from '@angular/core'; import { Aircrafts } from 'src/app/services/aircrafts.service'; import { AirlinesService} from 'src/app/services/airlines.service'; import { UserHttpService } from 'src/app/user-http.service'; import { Seats } from 'src/app/services/seats.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-airlines', templateUrl: './airlines.component.html', styleUrls: ['./airlines.component.css'] }) export class AirlinesComponent { nome : string = ""; revenue : number = 0; aircraft : Aircrafts[] = []; mail : string = ""; password : string = ""; setupData : any = {}; updateData : any = {}; constructor(private airlinesService : AirlinesService, private us : UserHttpService){} updateInfo(){ const id = this.us.get_mail(); this.updateData = { name: this.nome, revenue: this.revenue, aircrafts: this.aircraft }; this.airlinesService.updateAirlines(id,this.updateData).subscribe({ next : (res) => { console.log('Aggiornato con successo', res); }, error : (err) => { console.error('Errore aggiornamento', err); } }) } setupAirline() { const id = this.us.get_mail() this.setupData = { password: this.password, name: this.nome, mail: this.mail, aircrafts: this.aircraft }; this.airlinesService.setupAirline(id, this.setupData).subscribe({ next: res => console.log('Setup completato', res), error: err => console.error('Errore setup:', err) }); } addAircraft() { const newAircraft: Aircrafts = { _numAircraft: '', modello: '', seats: [] }; this.updateData.aircrafts?.push(newAircraft); } removeAircraft(index: number) { this.updateData.aircrafts?.splice(index, 1); } addSeat(aircraftIndex: number) { const newSeat: Seats = { _numSeat: '', class: '', legroom: false, isFree: true }; this.updateData.aircrafts?.[aircraftIndex].seats.push(newSeat); } removeSeat(aircraftIndex: number, seatIndex: number) { this.updateData.aircrafts?.[aircraftIndex].seats.splice(seatIndex, 1); } // Aggiunta / rimozione aerei per setup addSetupAircraft() { this.setupData.aircrafts.push({ _numAircraft: '', modello: '', seats: [] }); } removeSetupAircraft(index: number) { this.setupData.aircrafts.splice(index, 1); } addSetupSeat(aircraftIndex: number) { this.setupData.aircrafts[aircraftIndex].seats.push({ _numSeat: '', class: '', legroom: false, isFree: true }); } removeSetupSeat(aircraftIndex: number, seatIndex: number) { this.setupData.aircrafts[aircraftIndex].seats.splice(seatIndex, 1); } }
